ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

3. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 21

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 7

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

8. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 65

9. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 9
   D. 12

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

11. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 100
   D. 50

12. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 44
   D. 30

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

15. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

16. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

17. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

18. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

20. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

21. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

22. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 18

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
